verdict.rationale: Datalab documents reusable, versioned Pipelines, a CLI, and webhooks for job completion. None of this evidence shows a way to schedule jobs to run on a recurring basis (cron, timers, or triggers). Pipelines and on-demand API calls are one-off executions, not a recurring schedule, and users would need external schedulers, which earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
